# CVE Utils

> AI First Go library + cross-platform CLI for CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) identifier processing. 30+ deterministic, single-purpose functions covering format/validate, extract, compare/sort, filter/group, generate, set operations, range parsing and statistics. Zero CVE-format reinvention — install the binary or `go get` the package and call typed functions.

Module path: `github.com/scagogogo/cve-skills`
License: MIT · Language: Go 1.18+ · Repo: https://github.com/scagogogo/cve-skills

## Install

- Prebuilt binary (no toolchain): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scagogogo/cve-skills/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`
- Go CLI: `go install github.com/scagogogo/cve-skills/cmd/cve@latest`
- Go library: `go get github.com/scagogogo/cve-skills`
- Prebuilt for Linux / macOS / Windows / FreeBSD × amd64 / arm64 / arm / 386, plus deb/rpm/apk.

## Core functions

- Format & Validation: `Format`, `IsCve`, `IsContainsCve`, `ValidateCve`, `IsCveYearOk`, `IsCveYearOkWithCutoff`, `FormatSeq`
- Extraction: `ExtractCve`, `ExtractFirstCve`, `ExtractLastCve`, `Split`, `ExtractCveYear(AsInt)`, `ExtractCveSeq(AsInt)`
- Compare & Sort: `CompareCves`, `CompareByYear`, `SubByYear`, `SortCves`
- Filter & Group: `FilterCvesByYear`, `FilterCvesByYearRange`, `GetRecentCves`, `GroupByYear`, `RemoveDuplicateCves`
- Generate: `GenerateCve`, `GenerateFakeCve`
- Set operations: `IntersectCves`, `UnionCves`, `DiffCves`
- Batch validation: `ValidateCves`, `FilterValidCves`
- Range & Pattern: `ParseCveRange`, `IsCvesConsecutive`, `FilterCvesByPattern`
- Statistics: `CountByYear`, `YearRange`, `SeqRange`

## Typical pipeline

```go
cves := cve.SortCves(cve.RemoveDuplicateCves(cve.ExtractCve(text)))
```
